Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Latin8

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Latin8
public class Latin8 extends Object
Latin 8-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_LATIN8 section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x18.
